title: Q08 DSR context for window-sweep arms (OWNER-DEC-Q08-SWEEP-ARM-CONTEXT-20260914 = way 1): dsr_cohort accepts the sealed window-sweep ledger (qm.window-sweep.v1, config_sweep/window_sweep) as the search history for a candidate whose EA is a sweep arm; every arm of the programme (winners AND losers, controls included) is a trial; prescreen-skipped census years (hold PRESCREEN_SKIPPED with skip authority) count as zero-trade measurements instead of INCOMPLETE_TRIAL; tests + offline replay on QM5_41115/XTIUSD and QM5_41158/XTIUSD; no DSR formula, gate threshold or candidate-universe change.
why_now: OWNER 2026-09-14 17:3xZ: 'Weg 1, das Winsweep-Ledger als DSR-Suchhistorie plus die Prescreen-Skip-Regel in einem Codex-Ticket'. 9 Q08 rows that passed Q02-Q07 (7 winsweep arms QM5_41115/41158/41176/41131/41381/41423 XTIUSD, 2x QM5_12115/XAUUSD) have no DSR context: dsr_cohort._find_ledger only knows DL-089 ledgers, and a single-configuration declaration would be false because the arms ARE an optimisation search. Two class-C rows (QM5_21507 sell_032/2025 cell 2c1a2b99, QM5_20266 buy_010) fail INCOMPLETE_TRIAL only because the prescreen skipped a year. Also 10163 (ablation_04 set) and 10932 (ablation_02 set) lock ablation series and need the same 'search history' treatment (ablation runs as trials) or an explicit retire.
acceptance: dsr_cohort.assemble(conn, row, payload) returns a sealed cohort for the Q08 rows of QM5_41115/XTIUSD and QM5_41158/XTIUSD with selection_mode identifying the window-sweep source, effective_trial_count == number of arms in the sealed ledger (losers and controls included), losers_included true, and the cohort daily-return matrix built from the arms' native reports exactly like the DL-089 path (same peer-metric code, no new formula)

the sealed ledger is authenticated the way config_sweep.authenticate_ledger / window_sweep.authenticate_ledger do it (declaration sha, ledger sha, rerun and promotion amendments, stage-B cells); a ledger that fails authentication fails closed with a named reason

prescreen-skipped years: a census cell held PRESCREEN_SKIPPED whose skip authority is present in the sealed prescreen manifest (dl089_prescreen.staged_keys / project_row semantics used by the scheduler) is treated as a measured year with zero trades for the DSR peer metric; the arm remains a trial; any other non-terminal cell still raises INCOMPLETE_TRIAL; unit test for both cases

offline replay evidence: assemble() for 21507/XAUUSD and 20266/XTIUSD no longer raises INCOMPLETE_TRIAL (or the remaining reason is named); replay for 41115/41158 recorded under docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-14_q08_context_repair/sweep_arm_replay.md with trial counts

no change to gate thresholds, the DSR/FDR formula, keep/control fractions, candidate universes or any stored verdict; append-only; workers need an idle-aware staggered reload afterwards (session_tools/reload_chunk84.py pattern) - do not restart workers yourself
